reason: I like handing things off, but this is demo money today and the real-money version doesn't even have a broker partner named or a price. I'm not signing up for a paid plan where an AI moves my actual savings until someone tells me who's on the hook when it screws up.
objection: Who is liable if the agent loses money? A cute pet and a downloadable record don't answer that. My robo-adviser and my broker are regulated and insured; I don't know what this is.
would_change_my_mind: A named, licensed broker holding the money with SIPC coverage, plus a clear written statement of who pays if the agent breaks my limits or makes a bad trade.
